title: Natan Novum · Product designer
subtitle: I make software products more effective, easier to use, and focused on delivering the value customers are willing to pay for. See case studies of my best work.

posts.title: Developing an unbreakable website layout engine
posts.description: So many projects took forever to launch because we wanted an impressive website. There’s never enough time to develop it from scratch, but with themes, you end up wasting even more time hacking the code to fix their quirks. Neutrino was made to end that nonsense once and for all.

posts.title: Seoul Beauty Club
posts.description: Redesign of an AI-powered skincare app to improve conversion, stickiness, and retention, while consolidating UX/UI between the responsive web and iOS apps.

posts.title: Aleph Design System
posts.description: 0→1 development of a custom design system and a v2 expansion to 32 components totaling 95 variants. It grew from powering a single product into Aleph's global standard.
